description:
iitjobs brings live IT job search into ChatGPT.  Describe the role you want in
  plain language — "remote Java developer jobs in the USA," "DevOps roles in
  Bangalore," "entry-level QA, hybrid, Texas" — and get real, current openings
  from iitjobs.com's global index: title, company, location, work mode, required
  experience, key skills, and salary where available, each with a direct link
  to view and apply on iitjobs.com.

  Refine your search conversationally — narrow by skill, experience level,
  location, or work mode, and page through thousands of results. When a job
  fits, click through to iitjobs.com to apply.

  iitjobs is a global IT job portal serving software engineers, data and AI
  professionals, DevOps, QA, and every IT specialty, with openings across the
  USA, India, and worldwide. Searching is free and requires no account.

defaultPrompt: Find remote Java developer jobs in the USA
I know React and Node.js — find me remote full-stack jobs
What .NET jobs are open in Hyderabad right now?
